qc_pets_purchase_rebate_cad_per_bus.source_agency: Gouvernement du Quebec, Programme d'electrification du transport scolaire (PETS), Volet 1
qc_pets_purchase_rebate_cad_per_bus.source: Decret 728-2024 ($3,750,000 CAD / 30 buses = Autobus Campeau inc.) and Decret 736-2024 ($875,000 CAD / 7 buses = Autobus R.O.B.O inc.), Gazette officielle du Quebec, 1 mai 2024 -- both independently resolve to the same $125,000 CAD/bus figure.
qc_pets_purchase_rebate_cad_per_bus.note: Value is a derived estimate from two real, independently-published decree amounts that both compute to the same per-bus figure -- not an official published flat-rate schedule. PETS may specify amounts by bus type (A/C/D) that this flat estimate does not capture; treat as representative, not exact. Applies only to Quebec (province == 'QC'). No equivalent provincial or federal automatic BEV purchase incentive was found for any other Canadian region after a real search pass -- see canadian_regional_pricing_gaps for what was checked (iMHZEV explicitly excludes school buses/transit; ZETF is competitive/capped, not automatic, and reportedly exhausted since 2025 per industry reporting; no NB-specific program found, corroborated by two independent research passes this session).

cng_fuel_price.status: No Canadian-specific CNG fuel price benchmark found after search (Aug 2026). Resolved via FX conversion of the US AFLEET default per fx_rates.json -- see REF_PRICE_CNG_DGE in the assumptions matrix for the converted figure and rate used.

hydrogen_fuel_price.status: No Canadian-specific hydrogen fuel price benchmark found after search (Aug 2026). Resolved via FX conversion of the US NREL H2A defaults per fx_rates.json -- see REF_PRICE_H2_KG_SMALL / REF_PRICE_H2_KG_MED in the assumptions matrix.

vehicle_capex_all_pathways.status: No published Canadian dealer list pricing exists for any pathway (commercial bus sales are quote-based, not publicly listed, in both countries). Real Canadian distributors identified for citation context (Girardin Blue Bird: QC/ON/Maritimes; Dynamic: BC/AB/YT) but no usable price figure. Resolved via FX conversion of the US AFLEET defaults.

infrastructure_capex_bev_h2_cng.status: NRCan ZEVIP publishes subsidy amounts (up to 50% of cost, capped per connector), not underlying installation cost -- not usable as a baseline. Resolved via FX conversion of the US AFLEET/NREL defaults.

maintenance_cost_per_mile_all_pathways.status: CUTA (Canadian Urban Transit Association) publishes member-only fleet statistics; no public per-mile/per-km maintenance benchmark found for any pathway. Resolved via FX conversion of the US AFLEET defaults.

bev_incentive_outside_quebec.status: No automatic federal or provincial BEV purchase incentive found for any Canadian region other than Quebec after a real search pass (Aug 2026). iMHZEV explicitly excludes school buses and public transit. ZETF is a competitive, capped grant program (up to 50% of eligible costs), not an automatic credit, and industry reporting (Mar 2026) indicates it has been exhausted since 2025 with its successor fund's rules not yet published -- not modeled as a result. New Brunswick specifically was checked twice this session; no provincial program exists.
bev_incentive_outside_quebec.affected_param: REF_INCENTIVE_QC_PETS_BEV_BUS (region-gated to QC only, not a general CA incentive)
